newsitem.title: USA: U.S. awards $6 billion data processing pact.
newsitem.headline: U.S. awards $6 billion data processing pact.

text.p: The U.S. General Services Administration said Wednesday it has awarded a $6 billion contract for some federal agencies to contract out data processing requirements.
Computer Sciences Corp., SunGard Computer Services Inc. and Unisys Corp. are the three prime contractors of the arrangement.
The 10-year contract allows all federal agencies to shift its data processing requirements to outside firms, the General Services Administration said.
Federal agencies currently spend $2 billion annually on data centre operations, it said.

SunGard Computer services has teamed with GTE Corp. and Universal Hi-Tech Development Inc. Unisys teamed with Affiliated Computer Services Inc., Comdisco Inc., Q Systems and Horizon Data Corp., the agency said.
